name: Shenzhen YHLO Biotech Co., Ltd.
summary: Shenzhen YHLO Biotech Co., Ltd. researches, develops, produces, sells, and services in vitro diagnostic instruments and reagents in China and internationally. It offers chemiluminescence immunoassay analyzer, diabetes instruments and related reagents, automated biochemical analyzer, laboratory automation, tenfly phoenix blot analyzer, VISION Pro ESR analyzer, and VISION ESR analyzer. The company was founded in 2008 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
